random-international--rain-room.why_en: Rain falls everywhere except on you, so your body becomes the one dry spot in a storm.
random-international--rain-room.why_zh: 雨处处落下，唯独避开你，你的身体成了暴雨中唯一干燥的地方。

camille-utterback--text-rain.why_en: Letters of a poem fall like rain and pile up on your silhouette, so reading becomes a physical act.
camille-utterback--text-rain.why_zh: 诗句的字母像雨一样落下，堆在你的身影上，阅读变成了身体动作。

ivan-poupyrev--ishin-den-shin.why_en: Touching someone's ear passes a whisper through your finger, so a message travels by touch alone.
ivan-poupyrev--ishin-den-shin.why_zh: 用手指碰一下对方的耳朵，悄悄话就顺着身体传过去，信息只靠触碰传递。

oliver-kreylos--ar-sandbox.why_en: Pile up real sand and contour lines and water follow it instantly, so shaping a landscape is just moving sand.
oliver-kreylos--ar-sandbox.why_zh: 用手堆沙，等高线和水流立刻跟着变化，塑造地形就是推动沙子。

nintendo--face-raiders.why_en: Your own face turns into the enemy that bursts through the walls of your room.
nintendo--face-raiders.why_zh: 你自己的脸变成敌人，从房间墙壁里破墙而出。

otavio-good--word-lens.why_en: Point the camera at a foreign sign and the words are replaced in place by your language.
otavio-good--word-lens.why_zh: 把镜头对准外文招牌，上面的字就地换成你的语言。

scott-snibbe--shadow.why_en: After you walk away your shadow stays behind and repeats what you just did.
scott-snibbe--shadow.why_zh: 你走开之后，影子留在原地，重复你刚才的动作。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--under-scan.why_en: A stranger's portrait appears inside your shadow and looks up at you, turning a passing shadow into a meeting.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--under-scan.why_zh: 陌生人的影像出现在你的影子里抬头看你，路过的影子变成了一次相遇。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--body-movies.why_en: Hidden portraits on a facade only show inside passers-by's giant shadows, so your shadow is the window.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--body-movies.why_zh: 建筑立面上的肖像只在路人的巨大影子里显现，你的影子就是窗口。

theo-watson--daisies.why_en: Flowers wilt under your feet and grow back after you leave, so your presence leaves a visible mark.
theo-watson--daisies.why_zh: 花朵在你脚下枯萎，你离开后又重新长出，你的存在留下看得见的痕迹。

camille-utterback--liquid-time.why_en: The closer you step to the image, the further that patch slips into the past, so distance becomes time.
camille-utterback--liquid-time.why_zh: 你离画面越近，那一块就越退回过去，距离变成了时间。

scott-snibbe--boundary-functions.why_en: Lines drawn between people on the floor show each person's personal space, which shrinks as more people arrive.
scott-snibbe--boundary-functions.why_zh: 地面上人与人之间画出的线标出每个人的个人空间，人越多，空间越小。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--sandbox.why_en: The hand you put in a small sandbox appears as a giant hand over the whole beach.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--sandbox.why_zh: 你伸进小沙盒的手，被投影成覆盖整片海滩的巨手。

chris-oshea--hand-from-above.why_en: A giant hand reaches into the big-screen feed of a square and picks up passers-by like toys.
chris-oshea--hand-from-above.why_zh: 一只巨手伸进广场大屏幕的实时画面，把路人像玩具一样拎起来。

mark-skwarek--leak-in-your-hometown.why_en: Point at any BP logo and crude oil gushes out of it, turning a brand into the scene of its own spill.
mark-skwarek--leak-in-your-hometown.why_zh: 对准任何 BP 标志，原油就从里面喷涌而出，品牌变成了它自己的漏油现场。

julian-oliver--the-artvertiser.why_en: Look through binoculars and street ads are replaced by artworks, so you can switch off advertising.
julian-oliver--the-artvertiser.why_zh: 透过望远镜看，街头广告被换成艺术作品，广告可以被你关掉。

golan-levin--eyeshine.why_en: The glint in your own eyes is caught and shown back so they glow like a night animal's.
golan-levin--eyeshine.why_zh: 捕捉你眼中的反光再显示给你看，你的眼睛像夜行动物一样发亮。

olafur-eliasson--your-uncertain-shadow-c.why_en: Five colored lamps split one shadow into a row of colored shadows that move with you.
olafur-eliasson--your-uncertain-shadow-c.why_zh: 五盏彩色灯把一个影子拆成一排彩色影子，跟着你一起移动。

golan-levin--messa-di-voce-installation.why_en: Your voice grows visible shapes out of your mouth that you can then push around with your body.
golan-levin--messa-di-voce-installation.why_zh: 你的声音从嘴里长出看得见的形状，你还能用身体推动它们。

chris-oshea--body-swap.why_en: You control the on-screen body of the person beside you while they control yours.
chris-oshea--body-swap.why_zh: 你操控身旁那个人在屏幕上的身体，对方则操控你的。

msr-benko-wilson--lightspace.why_en: Scoop a projected photo off the table, carry it in your hand and pour it onto the wall, as if data were liquid.
msr-benko-wilson--lightspace.why_zh: 把投影照片从桌上捧起，托在手里，再倒到墙上，数据像液体一样可以搬运。

jun-rekimoto--pick-and-drop.why_en: Pick up a file with a pen on one screen and drop it on another, treating data as a physical object.
jun-rekimoto--pick-and-drop.why_zh: 用笔在一块屏幕上拿起文件，放到另一块屏幕上，数据被当作实物对待。

chris-oshea--out-of-bounds.why_en: Shine an X-ray flashlight at a wall and see the hidden room behind it.
chris-oshea--out-of-bounds.why_zh: 用一支 X 光手电照向墙壁，就能看到墙后隐藏的空间。

tamiko-thiel--carnation-rain.why_en: Virtual carnations rain down on the square where the Carnation Revolution happened, marking history in place.
tamiko-thiel--carnation-rain.why_zh: 虚拟康乃馨落在康乃馨革命发生的广场上，在原地标记这段历史。

blair-macintyre--voices-of-oakland.why_en: Walk through a cemetery and hear the people buried there tell their stories at their own graves.
blair-macintyre--voices-of-oakland.why_zh: 走进墓园，在每座坟前听安葬在那里的人讲自己的故事。

sander-veenhof--we-ar-in-moma.why_en: An uninvited AR show hangs inside MoMA, showing that no one controls who exhibits in virtual space.
sander-veenhof--we-ar-in-moma.why_zh: 一场未经邀请的 AR 展览挂进了 MoMA，说明虚拟空间里没人能决定谁来展出。

teamlab--sketch-aquarium.why_en: A fish a child colors on paper is scanned in and swims away in the shared aquarium.
teamlab--sketch-aquarium.why_zh: 孩子在纸上涂色的鱼被扫描进去，在共享的水族馆里游走。

krzysztof-wodiczko--tijuana-projection.why_en: A factory worker's live face and voice fill a giant public dome, so an unheard person takes over a monument.
krzysztof-wodiczko--tijuana-projection.why_zh: 工厂女工的实时面孔和声音占满巨大的公共球幕，平时无人倾听的人接管了一座地标。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--subtitled-public.why_en: Each visitor is labeled with a projected verb, and the only way to pass it on is to touch someone else.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--subtitled-public.why_zh: 每位访客身上都投着一个动词，要摆脱它，只能去触碰别人。

chris-sugrue--delicate-boundaries.why_en: Light bugs crawl out of the screen and onto the hand that touches it, so the image escapes its frame.
chris-sugrue--delicate-boundaries.why_zh: 光做的小虫从屏幕里爬出来，爬到触碰屏幕的手上，画面逃出了边框。

zach-lieberman--the-eyewriter.why_en: A paralyzed graffiti artist draws with his eyes and the tags appear live on city buildings.
zach-lieberman--the-eyewriter.why_zh: 一位瘫痪的涂鸦艺术家用眼睛画画，作品实时出现在城市建筑上。

karolina-sobecka--wildlife.why_en: A projected tiger runs along the buildings beside a moving car, keeping pace and stopping when the car stops.
karolina-sobecka--wildlife.why_zh: 投影出的老虎沿着街边建筑与行驶的汽车并肩奔跑，车停它也停。

julian-oliver--levelhead.why_en: Rooms hide inside a cube in your hand, and tilting the real cube walks a tiny figure through them.
julian-oliver--levelhead.why_zh: 几个房间藏在你手中的方块里，倾斜真实的方块就能带小人穿过它们。

random-international--audience.why_en: A crowd of mirrors turns in unison to stare at you, so the visitor becomes the one being watched.
random-international--audience.why_zh: 一群镜子齐刷刷转向盯着你，观众变成了被观看的人。

valentin-heun--reality-editor-programmin.why_en: Drag a line between two real objects on your phone and they are wired together.
valentin-heun--reality-editor-programmin.why_zh: 在手机画面里从一个实物拉一条线到另一个实物，它们就被连接起来。
